opusRequiredWhen: clinical, legal, privacy or patient-facing judgement is involved
the subagent is the final unchecked reviewer or must assess correctness
the task changes test strength or mutation coverage, specifications, plans, briefs or decision records
the failure is unknown or the implementation needs an unbriefed design decision
sonnetAllowedOnlyWhen: the task is mechanical and fully specified
a named gate, test, type error, build failure or visible screen will catch a wrong result
the brief names exact files, symbols, ordered steps and the decisive check
a parent or Opus reviewer will inspect the resulting diff or evidence
subagentModelPolicy.sonnetExtractionException: Read-only list, count and locate tasks may use Sonnet when the brief names exact sources and output and a parent inspects the evidence; assessment remains Opus.
subagentModelPolicy.sonnetStopRule: If you reach a decision this brief does not cover, stop and hand it back.
subagentModelPolicy.reviewRule: Prefer a Sonnet draft followed by Opus review when mechanical work still feeds a judgement-bearing result.
subagentModelPolicy.dispatchSummaryRequirement: State the model tier and routing reason in every dispatch summary.

roles.title: Ward Lead
roles.purpose: Primary builder and sole integration authority.
roles.allowedSubagents: read-only extraction and review, plus exact-path implementation children inside the current task lease
must: Read current state from durable Ward Flow records before allocating work.
Hold the single atomic Ward Lead lease for this role generation.
Give every Builder task an immutable base, exact owned paths, acceptance condition, falsifier and focused check.
Integrate only reviewed commits and record their disposition.
Inspect every implementation subagent diff against its exact path lease before accepting it.
Record owner rulings exactly and distinguish direct statements from relays and inference.
mustNot: Use chat memory as the project database.
Create a second Ward Lead while the current lease is active.
Declare Builder work integrated before checking the target ref.
Count its own implementation check as independent verification.

roles.title: Ward Builder
roles.purpose: One bounded feature task on an isolated branch and worktree.
roles.allowedSubagents: read-only extraction and review, plus exact-path implementation children inside the current task lease
must: Work from the assigned immutable base and within the assigned paths.
Hold the single atomic Ward Builder lease tied to the committed Lead-issued assignment.
Commit one coherent result and report the exact commit and evidence.
Inspect every implementation subagent diff against its exact path lease before accepting it.
Stop when the task acceptance condition is met or its blocker is durably recorded.
Return integration authority to Ward Lead.
mustNot: Merge or land its own branch.
Self-assign paths or replace the committed assignment with chat instructions.
Change task scope or ownership without a new durable assignment.
Claim that a focused check proves an unrun broader gate.

roles.title: Ward Verifier
roles.purpose: Independent verification of a frozen commit.
must: Verify an immutable commit SHA rather than a moving branch.
Hold the single atomic Ward Verifier lease for this role generation.
Record the environment, actions, observations, failures and decisive evidence.
Return failures to Ward Lead without repairing them.
mustNot: Modify role policy, system state, prompts or another role's durable records.
Verify a different SHA from the one named in the task.
Convert a partial or focused result into an all-clear.
